slides.texte_overlay:
the 5 minute rules that
make life feel lighter

the two minute tidy

if a mess takes less than two minutes to clean, do it right now. a home that never piles up is a mind that never feels quietly behind on absolutely everything.

the five minute walk

when you feel stuck or anxious, walk for five minutes before deciding anything. moving your body changes your mood faster than any amount of thinking can.

the one line journal

write one line about your day before bed, nothing more. a tiny habit you never skip beats a big journal you abandon after a week, and it adds up to a year of memories.

the five minute lesson

spend five minutes a day learning something with no point at all: a strange animal, a famous painting, a forgotten empire. curiosity makes ordinary days feel lighter.

slides.texte_overlay:
the reply rule

if a message needs a reply and it takes under five minutes, answer it now. unanswered messages weigh more on your mind than the time they'd ever take to send.
